params.message:
Rank relations by their share of the last three years

The handover list ranked clients and suppliers on one calendar year,
the last full one. A client with a large project in 2024 and nothing
invoiced in 2025 fell off the list, and the reason line read "in 2025"
as if nothing before counted.

Each share row now also carries its share of the last 36 months up to
today, and the agenda ranks and explains on that: "7,5% van de omzet,
de laatste drie jaar". The yearly columns stay for the export.
